# list-marker-space

- ID: `MD030`
- Category: Lists
- Default: on, severity warning
- Fixable: yes
- Tags: `ol`, `ul`, `whitespace`

One space, or one tab, separates each list marker from the item's text.

## Why

The spaces after a marker set the column that the item's later lines must reach.
Extra spaces make that column easy to miss.

## Options

Set them under `rules.list-marker-space.options`.

- `ul_single` (`integer`, default `1`): Spaces after the marker of each item of
  a bullet list whose items each take one line. 0 counts as 1, as in
  markdownlint.
- `ol_single` (`integer`, default `1`): Spaces after the marker of each item of
  a ordered list whose items each take one line. 0 counts as 1, as in
  markdownlint.
- `ul_multi` (`integer`, default `1`): Spaces after the marker of each item of a
  bullet list with an item of several lines. 0 counts as 1, as in markdownlint.
- `ol_multi` (`integer`, default `1`): Spaces after the marker of each item of a
  ordered list with an item of several lines. 0 counts as 1, as in markdownlint.

## Fix

The fix sets the spacing to the expected number of spaces. gomdlint reports some
items without a fix, such as one that holds a second paragraph, a code block or
a quote. gomdlint may report a finding without a fix when the fix would change a
line with one character in brackets, such as \[x\] or \[1\], or the lines around
it up to a blank line, because it could add or remove a task list checkbox. In a
document with raw HTML other than comments and plain br, wbr, hr or img tags,
gomdlint reports every finding without a fix.

## Configure

```yaml
rules:
  list-marker-space:
    options:
      ul_single: 1
```

Under `rules`, `list-marker-space: false` turns the rule off and
`list-marker-space: error` reports its findings as errors. The flag
`--disable list-marker-space` turns it off for one run.

## Silence one line

```markdown
<!-- markdownlint-disable-next-line list-marker-space -->
```
